headline: Duke Energy surpasses $65 million in North Carolina customer assistance with new $1 million investment in nonprofits
summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is investing $1 million in nonprofit organizations across North Carolina that help families, seniors and vulnerable residents access essentials such as food, housing, health care, utility assistance and other critical services. The grants will support front line organizations working to support community needs while helping them build the capacity to serve even more people.
